sentences.japanese: 目の前で繰り広げられるやり取りは、俺が入り込む隙なんて一ミリもない。
sentences.english: The exchange unfolding in front of my eyes had not a single millimetre of a gap in which for me to slip.

sentences.japanese: 犯人とその仲間は目を離した隙に逃げ出した。
sentences.english: The criminal and his companions ran away while we weren't looking.
You can't let your guard down for a second around that guy.

sentences.japanese: トムったら私が食卓から離れてる隙に、私のご飯つまみ食いしたのよ。
sentences.english: Tom ate some of my rice while I was away from the table.

sentences.japanese: トムが少し席を離れた隙に、メアリーは彼の教科書に落書きをした。
sentences.english: In the short time Tom was away from his desk, Mary scribbled something in his textbook.
